_comment: Merge the `hooks` key into .claude/settings.json (the agent cannot write there). PostToolUse formats edited files with Biome; Stop runs the definition-of-done checks and prints failures.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json|*.jsonc) pnpm exec biome format --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$( (pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && node scripts/tracker.mjs check) 2>&1 ) || { echo "Definition-of-done checks failed:"; echo "$out" | tail -40; exit 2; }
